summary: 实现 D1-2b L2 答案校验：decide 返回 Result<Decision, InvalidRequest>；新增 InvalidRequest{code}（crate 根导出，仅 Serialize）与 Outcome::InvalidResponse{code,failed_stage_index,failed_backend_kind}；14 个错误 code 逐字一致；请求非法时后端调用为 0，响应非法时不调用下一层；tests/l2_validation.rs 按规格 fixtures 与验收矩阵落成 23 个测试。
